overview.name: Pantry
overview.positioning: Smart meal planning built around Austin market deals. Smart sourcing + smart pricing, not either/or.
overview.audience: Austin adults who cook regularly, care about sourcing but also care about their budget

logo.accentRule: The period after 'Pantry' renders in sienna (#C8561A) via span styling — DO NOT remove the span wrapper
doNotUse: Any variation where the sienna period is missing or replaced
Pantry with the sienna period rendered in green

colors._comment: Core palette — these map directly to CSS variables in layout.ejs and planner.ejs

primary.name: Pantry Green
primary.usage: Primary actions, nav background, CTA buttons, verified sourcing badges

accent.name: Sienna
accent.usage: The period after 'Pantry', accent badges, section tags, deal highlights, star ratings

warmNeutral.name: Near Black
warmNeutral.usage: Body text, headings, dark backgrounds (footer, closing section)

paleGreen.name: Pale Green
paleGreen.usage: Badge backgrounds, tag backgrounds, savings highlights

800.usage: Hero H1, step numbers, stat numbers, price callouts

styles.italic: Use for emphasis in headlines — the green italic em style within h1, h2. Not for body copy.

display.note: Fraunces has optical sizing — 'opsz' param in the import is intentional for large display use

body.role: Body text, UI labels, navigation, descriptions

weights.300: Light — only for large descriptive text, body copy
weights.500: Medium — nav links, labels, form fields
weights.600: Semi-bold — CTAs, button text, strong labels
weights.700: Bold — only for section headers, strong emphasis

mono.role: Price displays, deal labels, numerical data
mono.note: Fraunces is currently used for price/number display. If adding DM Mono, import from Google Fonts.

typeScale.micro: 0.75rem, weight 600, letter-spacing 0.04–0.1em, uppercase — for badges, labels, section tags

iconography.style: Custom inline SVG — no icon library (no Heroicons, Phosphor, etc.)
iconography.colorMode: All SVG icons are currentColor or hardcoded to match brand palette
commonPatterns: Star icon: used for deal badges, recipe bookmarking. Sienna (#C8561A) fill.
Check-circle: used for sourcing verification, standard checkmarks. Green (#2A4D1E) fill.
Store/market icons: custom geometric SVGs for H-E-B, farmers market, CSA. Dark gradient backgrounds.

deconstructed.herb: Use for sourcing/farm badges — warm terracotta/gold tones

imagery.photoStyle: Editorial flatlay, warm morning light, wooden table surfaces. Ingredients + recipe cards + ledger. Rich, tactile, appetizing.
backgrounds: Near black (#1A1A1A) for dramatic contrast sections (footer, closing)

heroImage.prompt: Bright editorial flatlay, morning light, wooden kitchen table, recipe cards, handwritten ledger, Pantry brand jar with dry goods, heirloom tomatoes, farm eggs, fresh herbs, warm ambient mood
heroImage.style: editorial, warm, tactile, appetizing, Austin market aesthetic

doNotUse: Stock photo food shots that look like marketing
Generic AI-generated food imagery without Pantry's editorial warmth
Images with harsh lighting or cold color temperature
Any photo that doesn't feel local/Austin

motion.hoverStates: 0.2s ease transitions on color, background, box-shadow
motion.floatingCards: Subtle 4-5s ease-in-out infinite animation on hero floating badges
doNotUse: Bouncy spring animations on structural UI
Page-transition animations within the app (keep it fast)

gridDefaults: 3-col grid for deal cards, step cards, testimonials

appSurface._comment: Styles specific to the planner.ejs and app UI, not the landing page

donts: Don't use sienna as the primary brand color — green is primary
Don't replace Fraunces with a different serif (Playfair Display, Lora, etc.)
Don't use generic stock food photography
Don't remove the sienna period from the logo wordmark
Don't use more than 3 brand colors in a single composition
Don't put ultra-processed food imagery near Pantry Standard sections
Don't use the brand green (#2A4D1E) for text on white — use near-black (#1A1A1A)
